_comment: Community-maintained, best-effort list of MSI laptop BIOS versions, for Mcenter's 'a newer BIOS might unlock more features' hint. NOT from MSI, NOT official, NOT guaranteed current or accurate. Add an entry only from MSI's own support page for that exact model (Drivers & Downloads -> BIOS tab); include the date and the exact support URL you used. The app compares this purely informationally and never auto-updates anything.

boards.note: This is the version a contributor's own unit shipped with (verified locally); not confirmed as MSI's current newest release for this board. Please update this entry if you find a newer one on MSI's support page.
